mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info (user_id, order_date) VALUES (#{userCode}, NOW())

INSERT INTO order_item (order_info_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, price_per_unit) VALUES
(#{orderInfoId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.pricePerUnit})
INSERT INTO order_person (order_info_id, name, email, phone) VALUES (#{orderInfoId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_info_id, oi.user_id, op.name AS person_name, op.email AS person_email, op.phone AS person_phone, oi2.product_id AS item_product_id, oi2.product_name AS item_product_name, oi2.quantity AS item_quantity, oi2.price_per_unit AS item_price_per_unit, p.payment_id, p.order_info_id AS payment_order_info_id, p.payment_number, p.amount AS payment_amount, p.payment_method, p.created_at AS payment_created_at FROM order_info oi JOIN order_item oi2 ON oi.order_info_id = oi2.order_info_id JOIN order_person op ON oi.order_info_id = op.order_info_id JOIN payment p ON oi.order_info_id = p.order_info_id WHERE p.created_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, oi.order_info_id DESC LIMIT ${limit} OFFSET ${offset}
